Name: Custom NPC Puji.
Author: puffolotti
Description:
First of all: Sorry for my atrocious english. I'm not a necktie type, i'm doing all this for hobby, sorry if i tend to overlook semantic stuff. Altough i'm pretty enthusiastic with my current project i can't force myself to consider the documentation about it as critical as a mushroom soup or a safety belt, i can promise my mods won't turn your computer into a bomb, i'm confident my mods might be funny, but i absolutely don't want this hobby to become a chore.

Update may, 03, 2020 
I added a mod for NPC adventures. despite this character being a standalone NPC, the add on contains unique dialogues.

(I still don't know how to add dependencies here, so i'll repeat the link)[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5973]
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5973[/url]

___
This is my first character for Stardew Valley, inspired by the komato aliens from the videogame "Iji", by Daniel Remar.

I plan to add other 3 characters in this batch, Asha the assassin, Ansaksie the valkyrie and a human with a komato citizienship, Ava Lee.
Each one will be indipendent, altough they might talk about a colleague not yet installed as if they are there but very good at eluding human's attention.
It will be implied that they reach Stardew Valley about 10 years after the events of "Iji"

There isn't much to say here about the character, that wouldn't spoil the fun of learning to know her and investigating the reasons that brought the fearsome komato army in Stardew Valley.

I can promise this: you will be surprised by the complexity of the character, and by the fact some informations will be lost if player focuses on befriending her as fast as possible. 

About her being sexy or skimpy, she indulges in military humor, sometimes. And she wears a bikini when going to the beach... It is my policy to follow the guidelines.
This isn't a warning for bigots like:"if you don't want to see sexy stuff stay away."
I'm just warning honest workers looking for sexy-skimpy stuff: "what you might be expecting when a mod is labeled sexy/skimpy won't happen here. if that's what you were looking for, this mod might be a waste of time."

She can be dated and married.
Soon i'll add festival locations and Companion NPC, a word about the latter: Komato are better companions than humans, when it comes to fighting. The reason for this is in their physical superiority. As i develop the komato characters i'll add some downsides to choosing them to accompany the player in adventures. I plan to program them in a way that forces the player to balance the attention they gives to humans and the attention they give to komato. 

At the start of the game Puji will never leave the proximity of the mine, maybe she'll spend some time by Demetrius's lab. it's up to the player's interactions to convince her to visit the rest of Stardew Valley.

Right now there aren't embarassing questions or events, i'll think about how to organize them once i'll have a draft of all the 4 komato character, wich it should take about a month. The version 1.0.0 of Puji is slighly modified in order not to spoil the future version, that's supposed to interact with the other komato and the human population.

The fact i can't write proper english should give them an alien vibe.

I hope you like it. Let me know if there is any bug or grammar errors that are intolerable even when committed by a ueber-cute7ft tall curvy blue bunny-woman.

-
